newsitem.title: GERMANY: Siemens wins Malaysia phone order.
newsitem.headline: Siemens wins Malaysia phone order.

text.p: German industrial group Siemens AG said on Monday its public networking unit (ON) won an order to install a digital switching system for a Malaysian telecommunicaitons carrier.
The system would provide Mutiara Telecommunications Sdn Bhd of Kuala Lumpur with 200,000 phone connections. Siemens did not disclose the value of the contract.
Mutiara Telecom planned to invest 280 million marks ($157.5 million) over the next two years to build a network that integrates conventional telephone calls and high-speed, digital ISDN functions.
Siemens is handling the installing and servicing of Mutiara Telecom's digital systems.
In the six-month period to March 31, ON's sales rose 31 percent to 6.3 billion marks while orders increased 52 percent to nine billion marks. Siemens planned to release nine-month results on July 21.
